worktree.setup: mise exec -- corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && mise exec -- corepack pnpm --filter @open-design/daemon rebuild better-sqlite3 --pending
worktree.teardown: namespace=$(basename "$PWD"); mise exec -- corepack pnpm tools-dev stop --namespace "$namespace"

dev.command: namespace=$(basename "$PWD"); exec ports run open-design -- sh -c 'exec mise exec -- corepack pnpm tools-dev run web --namespace "$1" --daemon-port "$DAEMON_PORT" --web-port "$WEB_PORT"' sh "$namespace"

cleanup.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); lease_pid=$(ports leases --json | mise exec -- node -e 'let input = ""; process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8"); process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => input += chunk); process.stdin.on("end", () => { const root = process.argv[1]; const matches = JSON.parse(input).filter((lease) => lease.project === "open-design" && lease.worktree === root); if (matches.length > 1) { console.error(`multiple Open Design port leases found for ${root}`); process.exit(1); } if (matches[0]) process.stdout.write(String(matches[0].pid)); });' "$root"); if [ -n "$lease_pid" ]; then kill -TERM "$lease_pid"; fi; namespace=$(basename "$root"); mise exec -- corepack pnpm tools-dev stop --namespace "$namespace"

status.command: namespace=$(basename "$PWD"); mise exec -- corepack pnpm tools-dev status --namespace "$namespace" --json
